description: Our invoice approval process works like this: when an invoice arrives by email, an AP clerk downloads the PDF and prints it. The printed invoice is placed in the manager's physical inbox. The manager reviews and signs it, sometimes within the same day but often it sits for 2-3 days. The signed invoice is then scanned and emailed back to AP who manually re-enters the data into the ERP.

When a new hire starts, their manager submits an IT access request via email to the helpdesk. The helpdesk ticket is assigned to a technician who manually creates accounts in Active Directory, email, Slack, and the HRIS system one at a time. Each system requires a separate login and manual entry. The new hire often waits 1-3 days before having access to all required systems. If a system is missed, the new hire must submit a new ticket.

Employees submit paper expense reports with attached receipts. The report is reviewed by their direct manager, then forwarded to Finance via interoffice mail. Finance manually enters each expense line into the accounting system, checks receipts against policy, and issues a check. The full cycle from submission to reimbursement typically takes 3-4 weeks. Employees frequently follow up via email to check status.
